              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * @fileoverview Helpers for google.colab Python module.\n",
              " */\n",
              "(function(scope) {\n",
              "function span(text, styleAttributes = {}) {\n",
              "  const element = document.createElement('span');\n",
              "  element.textContent = text;\n",
              "  for (const key of Object.keys(styleAttributes)) {\n",
              "    element.style[key] = styleAttributes[key];\n",
              "  }\n",
              "  return element;\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// Max number of bytes which will be uploaded at a time.\n",
              "const MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE = 100 * 1024;\n",
              "\n",
              "function _uploadFiles(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const steps = uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId);\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  // Cache steps on the outputElement to make it available for the next call\n",
              "  // to uploadFilesContinue from Python.\n",
              "  outputElement.steps = steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  return _uploadFilesContinue(outputId);\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "// This is roughly an async generator (not supported in the browser yet),\n",
              "// where there are multiple asynchronous steps and the Python side is going\n",
              "// to poll for completion of each step.\n",
              "// This uses a Promise to block the python side on completion of each step,\n",
              "// then passes the result of the previous step as the input to the next step.\n",
              "function _uploadFilesContinue(outputId) {\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  const steps = outputElement.steps;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const next = steps.next(outputElement.lastPromiseValue);\n",
              "  return Promise.resolve(next.value.promise).then((value) => {\n",
              "    // Cache the last promise value to make it available to the next\n",
              "    // step of the generator.\n",
              "    outputElement.lastPromiseValue = value;\n",
              "    return next.value.response;\n",
              "  });\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "/**\n",
              " * Generator function which is called between each async step of the upload\n",
              " * process.\n",
              " * @param {string} inputId Element ID of the input file picker element.\n",
              " * @param {string} outputId Element ID of the output display.\n",
              " * @return {!Iterable<!Object>} Iterable of next steps.\n",
              " */\n",
              "function* uploadFilesStep(inputId, outputId) {\n",
              "  const inputElement = document.getElementById(inputId);\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = false;\n",
              "\n",
              "  const outputElement = document.getElementById(outputId);\n",
              "  outputElement.innerHTML = '';\n",
              "\n",
              "  const pickedPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    inputElement.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n",
              "      resolve(e.target.files);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  const cancel = document.createElement('button');\n",
              "  inputElement.parentElement.appendChild(cancel);\n",
              "  cancel.textContent = 'Cancel upload';\n",
              "  const cancelPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "    cancel.onclick = () => {\n",
              "      resolve(null);\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  });\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Wait for the user to pick the files.\n",
              "  const files = yield {\n",
              "    promise: Promise.race([pickedPromise, cancelPromise]),\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'starting',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "\n",
              "  cancel.remove();\n",
              "\n",
              "  // Disable the input element since further picks are not allowed.\n",
              "  inputElement.disabled = true;\n",
              "\n",
              "  if (!files) {\n",
              "    return {\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'complete',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  for (const file of files) {\n",
              "    const li = document.createElement('li');\n",
              "    li.append(span(file.name, {fontWeight: 'bold'}));\n",
              "    li.append(span(\n",
              "        `(${file.type || 'n/a'}) - ${file.size} bytes, ` +\n",
              "        `last modified: ${\n",
              "            file.lastModifiedDate ? file.lastModifiedDate.toLocaleDateString() :\n",
              "                                    'n/a'} - `));\n",
              "    const percent = span('0% done');\n",
              "    li.appendChild(percent);\n",
              "\n",
              "    outputElement.appendChild(li);\n",
              "\n",
              "    const fileDataPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {\n",
              "      const reader = new FileReader();\n",
              "      reader.onload = (e) => {\n",
              "        resolve(e.target.result);\n",
              "      };\n",
              "      reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);\n",
              "    });\n",
              "    // Wait for the data to be ready.\n",
              "    let fileData = yield {\n",
              "      promise: fileDataPromise,\n",
              "      response: {\n",
              "        action: 'continue',\n",
              "      }\n",
              "    };\n",
              "\n",
              "    // Use a chunked sending to avoid message size limits. See b/62115660.\n",
              "    let position = 0;\n",
              "    do {\n",
              "      const length = Math.min(fileData.byteLength - position, MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE);\n",
              "      const chunk = new Uint8Array(fileData, position, length);\n",
              "      position += length;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const base64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, chunk));\n",
              "      yield {\n",
              "        response: {\n",
              "          action: 'append',\n",
              "          file: file.name,\n",
              "          data: base64,\n",
              "        },\n",
              "      };\n",
              "\n",
              "      let percentDone = fileData.byteLength === 0 ?\n",
              "          100 :\n",
              "          Math.round((position / fileData.byteLength) * 100);\n",
              "      percent.textContent = `${percentDone}% done`;\n",
              "\n",
              "    } while (position < fileData.byteLength);\n",
              "  }\n",
              "\n",
              "  // All done.\n",
              "  yield {\n",
              "    response: {\n",
              "      action: 'complete',\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  };\n",
              "}\n",
              "\n",
              "scope.google = scope.google || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab = scope.google.colab || {};\n",
              "scope.google.colab._files = {\n",
              "  _uploadFiles,\n",
              "  _uploadFilesContinue,\n",
              "};\n",
              "})(self);\n",
              "</script> "
            ]

            "=================================================================\n",
            "TASK 2 COMPLETE\n",
            "=================================================================\n",
            "Rows used: 20640\n",
            "Training records: 16512\n",
            "Testing records: 4128\n",
            "Best model: OLS Linear Regression\n",
            "Best RMSE: 66788.2960\n",
            "Best MAE: 47282.1110\n",
            "Best R2: 0.6596\n",
            "\n",
            "Files created:\n",
            "- model_comparison.csv\n",
            "- actual_vs_predicted.png\n",

      ],
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# DATHEON TASK 2\n",
        "# Real Estate Housing Price Prediction\n",
        "# OLS vs Ridge vs Lasso Regression\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "import os\n",
        "import warnings\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "from google.colab import files\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV\n",
        "from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline\n",
        "from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer\n",
        "from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, PolynomialFeatures\n",
        "from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, Ridge, Lasso\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error, r2_score\n",
        "\n",
        "warnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\")\n",
        "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 65)\n",
        "print(\"DATHEON TASK 2: HOUSING PRICE PREDICTION\")\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 65)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. UPLOAD DATASET\n",
        "print(\"\\nSTEP 1: Upload your housing (1).txt file.\")\n",
        "uploaded = files.upload()\n",
        "\n",
        "if not uploaded:\n",
        "    raise ValueError(\"No file uploaded. Please upload housing (1).txt.\")\n",
        "\n",
        "filename = next(iter(uploaded))\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(filename)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nDataset loaded successfully!\")\n",
        "print(\"Dataset shape:\", df.shape)\n",
        "print(\"\\nFirst five rows:\")\n",
        "display(df.head())\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. CLEAN COLUMN NAMES AND IDENTIFY TARGET\n",
        "df.columns = df.columns.str.strip()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Support the California housing file supplied for this task.\n",
        "possible_targets = [\n",
        "    \"median_house_value\",\n",
        "    \"MedHouseVal\",\n",
        "    \"median_house_value\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "target = next((c for c in possible_targets if c in df.columns), None)\n",
        "\n",
        "if target is None:\n",
        "    raise ValueError(\n",
        "        \"Target column not found. Available columns: \"\n",
        "        + str(df.columns.tolist())\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert target to numeric and remove rows without a target.\n",
        "df[target] = pd.to_numeric(df[target], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "df = df.dropna(subset=[target]).copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove rows with invalid numeric target values.\n",
        "df = df[np.isfinite(df[target])].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. DATA EXPLORATION\n",
        "print(\"\\nSTEP 2: DATA EXPLORATION\")\n",
        "print(\"\\nDataset information:\")\n",
        "df.info()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nStatistical summary:\")\n",
        "display(df.describe(include=\"all\").T)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nMissing values by column:\")\n",
        "display(df.isnull().sum().to_frame(\"Missing Values\"))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot target distribution.\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
        "sns.histplot(df[target], kde=True)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Distribution of Median House Values\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Median House Value ($)\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Correlation heatmap for numeric columns.\n",
        "numeric_df = df.select_dtypes(include=np.number)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(11, 8))\n",
        "sns.heatmap(numeric_df.corr(), cmap=\"coolwarm\",\n",
        "            center=0, annot=True, fmt=\".2f\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Correlation Heatmap\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4. SPLIT FEATURES AND TARGET\n",
        "print(\"\\nSTEP 3: FEATURE ENGINEERING\")\n",
        "\n",
        "X = df.drop(columns=[target]).copy()\n",
        "y = df[target].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Remove columns that are completely empty.\n",
        "X = X.dropna(axis=1, how=\"all\")\n",
        "\n",
        "numeric_features = X.select_dtypes(include=np.number).columns.tolist()\n",
        "categorical_features = X.select_dtypes(\n",
        "    exclude=np.number\n",
        ").columns.tolist()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Numeric features:\", numeric_features)\n",
        "print(\"Categorical features:\", categorical_features)\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X, y, test_size=0.20, random_state=42\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Numeric preprocessing: impute, create interaction features,\n",
        "# then standardize. All transformations are fitted on training data.\n",
        "numeric_pipeline = Pipeline([\n",
        "    (\"imputer\", SimpleImputer(strategy=\"median\")),\n",
        "    (\"interactions\", PolynomialFeatures(\n",
        "        degree=2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False\n",
        "    )),\n",
        "    (\"scaler\", StandardScaler())\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Categorical preprocessing: impute and one-hot encode.\n",
        "categorical_pipeline = Pipeline([\n",
        "    (\"imputer\", SimpleImputer(strategy=\"most_frequent\")),\n",
        "    (\"encoder\", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=\"ignore\"))\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([\n",
        "    (\"numeric\", numeric_pipeline, numeric_features),\n",
        "    (\"categorical\", categorical_pipeline, categorical_features)\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Training records:\", len(X_train))\n",
        "print(\"Testing records:\", len(X_test))\n",
        "\n",
        "# 5. TRAIN AND TUNE MODELS\n",
        "print(\"\\nSTEP 4: TRAINING OLS, RIDGE AND LASSO\")\n",
        "\n",
        "model_configs = {\n",
        "    \"OLS Linear Regression\": (\n",
        "        LinearRegression(),\n",
        "        {}\n",
        "    ),\n",
        "    \"Ridge Regression\": (\n",
        "        Ridge(),\n",
        "        {\"model__alpha\": [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100]}\n",
        "    ),\n",
        "    \"Lasso Regression\": (\n",
        "        Lasso(max_iter=30000),\n",
        "        {\"model__alpha\": [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1]}\n",
        "    )\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "best_models = {}\n",
        "results = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for model_name, (estimator, param_grid) in model_configs.items():\n",
        "    print(f\"\\nTraining {model_name}...\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    pipeline = Pipeline([\n",
        "        (\"preprocessor\", preprocessor),\n",
        "        (\"model\", estimator)\n",
        "    ])\n",
        "\n",
        "    if param_grid:\n",
        "        search = GridSearchCV(\n",
        "            pipeline,\n",
        "            param_grid,\n",
        "            cv=3,\n",
        "            scoring=\"neg_root_mean_squared_error\",\n",
        "            n_jobs=-1\n",
        "        )\n",
        "        search.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "        best_pipeline = search.best_estimator_\n",
        "        best_params = search.best_params_\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        best_pipeline = pipeline\n",
        "        best_pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "        best_params = \"Default OLS parameters\"\n",
        "\n",
        "    predictions = best_pipeline.predict(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, predictions))\n",
        "    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, predictions)\n",
        "    r2 = r2_score(y_test, predictions)\n",
        "\n",
        "    best_models[model_name] = best_pipeline\n",
        "\n",
        "    results.append({\n",
        "        \"Model\": model_name,\n",
        "        \"Best Parameters\": str(best_params),\n",
        "        \"RMSE\": rmse,\n",
        "        \"MAE\": mae,\n",
        "        \"R2 Score\": r2\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(f\"RMSE: {rmse:.4f}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"MAE:  {mae:.4f}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"R2:   {r2:.4f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 6. COMPARE MODELS\n",
        "print(\"\\nSTEP 5: MODEL COMPARISON\")\n",
        "\n",
        "results_df = pd.DataFrame(results).sort_values(\"RMSE\")\n",
        "display(results_df.round(4))\n",
        "\n",
        "results_df.to_csv(\"model_comparison.csv\", index=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "best_model_name = results_df.iloc[0][\"Model\"]\n",
        "best_model = best_models[best_model_name]\n",
        "best_predictions = best_model.predict(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nBest model based on lowest test RMSE:\", best_model_name)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 7. ACTUAL VS PREDICTED PLOT\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
        "plt.scatter(y_test, best_predictions, alpha=0.35)\n",
        "\n",
        "lower = min(y_test.min(), best_predictions.min())\n",
        "upper = max(y_test.max(), best_predictions.max())\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot([lower, upper], [lower, upper], \"r--\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Actual House Value ($)\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Predicted House Value ($)\")\n",
        "plt.title(f\"Actual vs Predicted: {best_model_name}\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig(\"actual_vs_predicted.png\", dpi=150)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# 8. RESIDUAL ANALYSIS\n",
        "residuals = y_test - best_predictions\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "axes[0].scatter(best_predictions, residuals, alpha=0.35)\n",
        "axes[0].axhline(0, color=\"red\", linestyle=\"--\")\n",
        "axes[0].set_xlabel(\"Predicted House Value ($)\")\n",
        "axes[0].set_ylabel(\"Residual ($)\")\n",
        "axes[0].set_title(\"Residuals vs Predicted Values\")\n",
        "\n",
        "sns.histplot(residuals, kde=True, ax=axes[1])\n",
        "axes[1].set_xlabel(\"Residual ($)\")\n",
        "axes[1].set_title(\"Residual Error Distribution\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig(\"residual_analysis.png\", dpi=150)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# 9. FINAL SUMMARY\n",
        "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 65)\n",
        "print(\"TASK 2 COMPLETE\")\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 65)\n",
        "print(\"Rows used:\", len(df))\n",
        "print(\"Training records:\", len(X_train))\n",
        "print(\"Testing records:\", len(X_test))\n",
        "print(\"Best model:\", best_model_name)\n",
        "\n",
        "best_row = results_df.iloc[0]\n",
        "print(f\"Best RMSE: {best_row['RMSE']:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Best MAE: {best_row['MAE']:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Best R2: {best_row['R2 Score']:.4f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nFiles created:\")\n",
        "print(\"- model_comparison.csv\")\n",
        "print(\"- actual_vs_predicted.png\")\n",
        "print(\"- residual_analysis.png\")\n",
        "\n",

      ]
